headline: Spain says most Ceuta arrivals returned; at least 67 died
summary: Spain says about 60,000 people crossed from Morocco, most have returned, and a sea barrier is being installed after deadly attempts to enter the enclave.
script: Ceuta's crossing shows how a border emergency becomes a humanitarian crisis. Spain says about sixty thousand people arrived from Morocco, most have returned, and at least sixty-seven died. A sea barrier may slow crossings, but it cannot address why people take risks.
imageAlt: Spanish soldiers assist a migrant on a beach in Ceuta.

lines: Most have returned. At least 67 died
A new sea barrier is being installed
